📋 Prize Verification: Social Media Proof Required

Following Praesignis on LinkedIn/Facebook and sharing our official Cloud Skills Challenge post are required to qualify for a prize — not just a formality after winning. Even with the highest points, you won't be counted as a Top 3 or Lucky Draw winner without this.

Upload your proof via the assignment on Moodle: a screenshot showing you follow Praesignis, and a screenshot or link showing you shared our official post.

Do this before the month ends. If you're a top contender but haven't submitted proof, you'll be skipped and the next qualifying learner takes your spot.
